expectations.normal: No dashboard client registration or OFAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET needed; first consent binds one workspace and exact account grants.
expectations.rejectedToken: An unexpired rejected bearer refreshes once; valid refresh recovers without consent; revoked refresh shows existing Connect page immediately.
expectations.state: Stable refresh and version/selection compare-and-swap preserve a newer authorization.

E1_connect.evidence: no client env; browser demo sign-in -> Connect -> native consent (identity, permissions, choose accounts: 2 offered) -> Mara (1010) only -> callback /accounts lists only Mara; one AccountClient kind api bound to Northwind organization; one authorization granting only Mara; registration activated. Seeded custody has no provider session (profile 502 operation_unavailable, same as R1), so Mara got one through the app's Reconnect + documented provider simulation (needs_reconnect + provider_login_email, password-only form) -> 'Reconnect finished' -> /profile 200 'Connected profile'.

E3_accessOnlyInvalidation.semanticsConfirmedFirst: Two throwaway access tokens minted with the actual refresh grant. POST /v3/link/revoke token_type_hint=access_token on A returned 200; A 401; sibling B 200; app stored bearer 200; refresh grant still 200. So the actual server revokes only that access token, matching the OpenAPI text 'An access token revokes only itself'. No DB mutation fallback needed. Throwaways revoked afterwards.
E3_accessOnlyInvalidation.fixture: Revoked the app's stored access token with token_type_hint=access_token. It was locally unexpired (>2 min left, checked; ~14.7 min actual).
E3_accessOnlyInvalidation.expected: app /profile 200 without consent; new access token; refresh credential/version/selection stable; no new authorization
E3_accessOnlyInvalidation.actual: /profile 200 'Connected profile' at /profile. Wire (/tmp/ac69-r2/wire-recover.json): GET /v3/linked-accounts/{id} bearer 006204f7 401 invalid_token -> POST /v3/link/token refresh_token 200 (refresh fae04847 returned unchanged, new access ac8e3b05) -> GET /v3/linked-accounts/{id} 200 -> GET /v3/access/profile 200. Exactly one refresh. Stored refresh md5 9b6981d5, version 3280780d, selection unchanged; access token replaced; /accounts 200; authorization rows identical; no Developer rows.

E2_disconnectBeforeExpiry_F1.steps: real dashboard (15173) Overview -> sidebar Apps -> Manage Express example -> Disconnect -> confirm. Row stays 'Express example | Active | 0 | Manage'.
E2_disconnectBeforeExpiry_F1.timing: app call 713 ms after disconnect; stored access token had 872 s of local life left
E2_disconnectBeforeExpiry_F1.actual: /accounts 401 'Connect with OFAuth'; /profile 401 'Connect with OFAuth'. Wire (/tmp/ac69-r2/wire-disconnect.json): GET /v3/linked-accounts 401 invalid_token (bearer ac8e3b05) -> POST /v3/link/token refresh_token 400 invalid_grant; /profile: GET /v3/linked-accounts/{id} 401 invalid_token -> token 400 invalid_grant. One refresh per request, no loop, no 5xx. Direct refresh 400 invalid_grant. Provider custody connected for both accounts. No Developer rows.

E4_connectAgain.preApproval: on consent: still exactly one AccountClient (same oa_3ddd2d83), only the revoked authorization, dashboard row 0 accounts
E4_connectAgain.approval: consent offered 2 accounts; chose only Mara. Callback lists only Mara (by id). App selected_account_id reset to NULL by the new authorization (stale selection not reused), re-selected, /profile 200.
E4_connectAgain.staleCallback: The first connect's callback URL was not captured (see harnessFailures). Instead: new Connect -> Decline -> 'Authorization canceled'. Replaying that consumed callback returned 400 'Authorization expired'. Tokens (refresh md5 800a9e7a) and selection unchanged; profile still 200; authorizations unchanged. app_oauth.version changes when a new Connect starts, which is by design (it invalidates in-flight writes).
E4_connectAgain.final: authorizations [revoked: Mara], [active: Mara]; Leo never granted; one AccountClient; dashboard row 'Active | 1'. Developer ledgers unchanged; Operator usage/billing rows changed as expected.

E5_nonManager.reason: Not cheap here: requires a second user with a membership lacking manage_authorizations. The existing server gate in operator-api.ts rejects non-managers (access_denied) and sets canRegister = live Operator entitlement; the menu renders only when canRegister. Unit/integration coverage is from the parent only.
